data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: bucket with public-access-block, SSE, lifecycle 90d→Glacier IR
- dd-2: re-running reports no resource changes (idempotent)
- dd-3: .claude/dso-config.conf gets review_telemetry.bucket_name=<bucket>
- dd-4: bucket policy denies PutObject from non-Lambda principals (reads review_telemetry.lambda_role_arn)
- dd-5: missing IAM permissions → clear pre-flight error before any resource creation

Depends on: task-1 (f735-ad04-e3d2-4a88)

## Implementation Notes
Mirror plugins/dso/scripts/verify-aws-account.sh structure (already in tree).

### Header / overrides
- set -euo pipefail
- DSO_AWS_CMD env override (default: `aws`) — for PATH stubbing in tests
- DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD env override (default: `.claude/scripts/dso read-config`) — for config stubbing in tests
- AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 OR `--region us-east-1` on every s3api call

### Preflight phase (BEFORE any resource creation — dd-5)
1. `aws sts get-caller-identity` — fail if credentials don't resolve
2. `aws iam get-user` + `aws iam list-attached-user-policies` — enumerate required actions: s3:CreateBucket, s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock, s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration, s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration, s3:PutBucketPolicy
3. On ANY missing permission: exit 5 with stderr message naming missing perm(s); ZERO s3api create-bucket calls allowed

### Six ensure_* functions (each idempotent: head/get first, write only on mismatch)

1. `ensure_bucket`
   - `aws s3api head-bucket` → on 404 → `create-bucket --region us-east-1` (us-east-1 doesn't need LocationConstraint)
   - Bucket name: read from `review_telemetry.bucket_name` if present, else derive from `review_telemetry.bucket_name_prefix` + account-id-derived stable suffix (so reruns reuse name). Write back via write_config_key.

2. `ensure_public_access_block`
   - `aws s3api get-public-access-block` → on NoSuchPublicAccessBlockConfiguration OR mismatch → `put-public-access-block` with all 4 flags true
   - MUST run BEFORE ensure_policy (test 4)

3. `ensure_sse`
   - `get-bucket-encryption` → on missing OR mismatch → `put-bucket-encryption` with AES256

4. `ensure_lifecycle`
   - `get-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` → on missing OR mismatch → `put-bucket-lifecycle-configuration` with rule: Status=Enabled, Transition.Days=90, Transition.StorageClass=GLACIER_IR

5. `ensure_policy`
   - Build policy JSON from template + `review_telemetry.lambda_role_arn` (read via config)
   - Policy: Allow s3:PutObject Principal=lambda_role_arn; Deny s3:PutObject for NotPrincipal=lambda_role_arn (OR use aws:PrincipalArn != lambda_role_arn condition)
   - `get-bucket-policy` → compare to expected → on missing/mismatch → `put-bucket-policy`
   - dd-4

6. `write_config_key`
   - Write `review_telemetry.bucket_name=<bucket>` to .claude/dso-config.conf
   - Read existing file; if line present, rewrite ONLY that line via temp file + atomic rename; if absent, append
   - Preserves all other keys (test 6) AND rewrites stale value (test 7)

### Idempotency contract (dd-2)
On rerun where all 6 ensure_* checks pass (head/get matches desired): ZERO put-bucket-* / create-bucket calls.

### Test transition (RED → GREEN)
The RED test (task-1) must turn GREEN with this impl. Remove .test-index RED marker for tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh.

### chmod +x; ShellCheck-clean.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Script exists, executable, set -euo pipefail
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh && head -5 plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh | grep -q 'set -euo pipefail'
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
  Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] DSO_AWS_CMD + DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD overrides supported (PATH stubbable)
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO_AWS_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh && grep -q 'DSO_READ_CONFIG_CMD' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] Region pinned us-east-1
  Verify: grep -qE 'us-east-1|AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1' plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/aws-setup-bucket.sh
- [ ] All 8 task-1 test cases now pass GREEN
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-aws-setup-bucket.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] No new external dependencies
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD -- pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\+' | grep -qE 'boto3|cloudformation'
- [ ] .test-index RED marker removed for the test file (flipped to GREEN)
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'aws-setup-bucket\.sh.*test-aws-setup-bucket\.sh \[' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction.
